thread:
maya: Quick sync — need to finalize console visibility docket for Q2. Customers LumaHealth and ByteBank pushed for: cost breakdown per-route, error attribution (trace+stack), sampling knobs for traces, and embeddable dashboard snippets. We need to decide MVP surface + asks for Dedicated/private. Who can join 30m huddle?

sam: I'll join. can we scope to metric dashboards + trace hooks first? cost per-route is higher effort.

anika: +1. customers said they want per-token cost slice w/ outlier detection. Suggest: dashboards (4 widgets), trace hook + high-cardinality sampling, cost export.

liam: From infra: trace sampling + high-cardinality needs infra changes; estimate 3 sprints. Dashboard widgets + cost export are doable in 1 sprint.

maya: ok tradeoffs. Proposal: MVP = dashboards (agg cost per-route + error rate + latency p95), trace light-hook (span ids + error tag), export csv. Defer high-cardinality sampling to beta. @anika @liam thoughts?

anika: sounds good. also add launch criteria: customer test with Luma & ByteBank, SLO for dashboard data lag < 30s, cost accuracy ±5%.

liam: Agree. note: Dedicated customers may need encryption-at-rest for export. Add as enterprise blocker.

sam: I'll create a PR with spec + acceptance tests. pinging @ops for rollout checklist :bell: 

ops-bot: New runbook created: /runbooks/console-visibility-docket. Assigned to oncall: claire.

claire: saw this, will review rollout checklist tomorrow. one ask: feature flag per-tenant.

liam: example flag: `visibility.v1.dashboards=true` and `visibility.v1.trace_hook=light` — we'll tie to rollout.

maya: Good call. we'll gate sampling and export behind flags. Thanks all. I'll schedule 30m huddle tomorrow 10am PT. Agenda in doc: https://redwood.example/notes/visibility-docket

maya: (adding) decision summary to include: MVP scope, acceptance tests, rollout flagging, enterprise blockers list, and customer validation plan. I will capture and share after the huddle.
